scope: Consumer review for the guarded refresh from @ai-matrx/agents 0.14.0 to 0.14.3 and @ai-matrx/design-system 0.46.2 to 0.46.3. No install, build, tests, or browser verification were run in this lane.

update_receipt.observedLockfileDelta: Only agents 0.14.0 to 0.14.3 and design-system 0.46.2 to 0.46.3, including transitive references; package.json already declares both as latest.

agents.actualChanges: Archived agent rows now show a default Archived badge; AgentListDropdown sizes itself to available space below its trigger when at least 300px fits; panelHeightBelow is exported. The 0.14.3 mandate-key snapshot is present. No required host prop or changed call signature.
agents.extensionUsage: Four AgentListDropdown call sites in ChatView, PilotView, SettingsView, and AiExtractTab. None passes a labels override or uses panelHeightBelow; all inherit the package behavior.

designSystem.actualChanges: BottomSheet overlay and content z-index rose from z-50 to z-[10000], matching the dialog layer. The installed dist/index.js contains the new class. No API change.
designSystem.changelogAccuracy: The 0.46.3 changelog calls this docs/metadata drift with no intended source change, but the tag diff and installed bundle show a real runtime change.
designSystem.extensionUsage: No direct BottomSheet or TabbedBottomSheet call sites in extension src.

verdict: No extension source adoption required for these package versions. Root owns package gate, compile, tests, browser verification, and release retry; none is claimed here.
